text: {"memo": "As of 2025-03-31, Alphabet's most recently completed fiscal year was calendar 2024. Revenue rose to about $350 billion, up roughly 14% from about $307 billion in 2023, driven by search, YouTube ads and cloud growth. Net income increased to about $100 billion, or $8.04 per share, while operating income was about $218 billion and operating margin about 62%. In 2023, revenue was about $307 billion with net income around $60 billion and EPS near $6.58, down versus 2024 but still strong. The prior year, 2022, reported revenue of about $283 billion, net income near $60 billion, and EPS around $5.24, as macroeconomic and ad-spending pressures weighed on growth. Cash flow remained robust, with operating cash flow around $110 billion in 2024 and free cash flow above $90 billion. Margins expanded notably in 2024 versus 2023, reflecting disciplined cost controls and higher profitability. Growth was strongest in 2024, with revenue up double digits and earnings power improving. The fiscal years cited are calendar years 2022, 2023 and 2024. On balance, the business looks resilient, though valuation and competition remain key risks. We remain neutral on the stock pending clarity on ad recovery and AI spending."}
